<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Sajal Monga</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Space+Grotesk:wght@400;500;700&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --bg:#0a0a0c;
    --card:#111214;
    --border:#232428;
    --text:#f0f0f0;
    --text-dim:#84868c;
    --accent:#7c9eff;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box; margin:0; padding:0;}
  html,body{
    background:var(--bg);
    color:var(--text);
    font-family:'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
    min-height:100vh;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    padding:48px 20px;
  }
  .card{
    width:100%;
    max-width:420px;
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    align-items:center;
    text-align:center;
  }
  .avatar{
    width:120px;
    height:131px;
    object-fit:cover;
    border-radius:24px;
    border:1px solid var(--border);
    margin-bottom:28px;
  }
  .greeting{
    font-family:'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;
    font-size:13px;
    letter-spacing:0.04em;
    color:var(--text-dim);
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:8px;
    margin-bottom:10px;
  }
  .cursor{
    width:7px;
    height:14px;
    background:var(--accent);
    display:inline-block;
    animation:blink 1.1s steps(1) infinite;
  }
  @keyframes blink{
    0%,49%{opacity:1;}
    50%,100%{opacity:0;}
  }
  h1{
    font-size:40px;
    font-weight:700;
    letter-spacing:-0.02em;
    line-height:1.1;
    margin-bottom:20px;
  }
  .bio{
    font-size:15px;
    line-height:1.6;
    color:var(--text-dim);
    max-width:340px;
    margin-bottom:32px;
  }
  .bio b{
    color:var(--text);
    font-weight:500;
  }
  .divider{
    width:100%;
    height:1px;
    background:var(--border);
    margin-bottom:24px;
  }
  .tags{
    display:flex;
    flex-wrap:wrap;
    justify-content:center;
    gap:10px;
  }
  .tag{
    font-family:'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;
    font-size:12px;
    color:var(--text-dim);
    border:1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius:100px;
    padding:7px 14px;
  }
  .tag span{
    color:var(--accent);
    margin-right:6px;
  }
  .links{
    display:flex;
    gap:12px;
  }
  .link{
    font-family:'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;
    font-size:13px;
    color:var(--text-dim);
    border:1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius:100px;
    padding:9px 18px;
    text-decoration:none;
    transition:border-color 0.15s, color 0.15s;
  }
  .link:hover{
    border-color:var(--accent);
    color:var(--text);
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="card">
  <img class="avatar" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Sajal Monga">

  <div class="greeting"><span class="cursor"></span>hey there</div>
  <h1>Sajal Monga.</h1>

  <p class="bio"><b>Sophomore</b> pursuing CSE with a specialization in <b>Cloud Computing</b>. Building things, breaking things, figuring it out.</p>

  <div class="divider"></div>

  <div class="links">
    <a class="link" href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/sajal-monga-40a2742b4/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">LinkedIn</a>
    <a class="link" href="mailto:sajal1105@gmail.com">Email</a>
  </div>
</div>

</body>
</html>
